description: hspfbintoolbox is a Python command-line and library tool for reading binary output from the Hydrological Simulation Program Fortran model. Its README describes cataloguing series in an HSPF file and extracting selected time series for use in other programs. Users supply a compatible HSPF binary output; the tool prints or redirects the requested hydrological results. Geographic coverage is the watershed encoded in the upstream HSPF study. GitHub metadata states BSD-3-Clause licensing, and the README provides pip and Conda installation routes. A limitation is that the reader does not verify calibration or physical validity of the HSPF simulation and may depend on the binary format version. It can prepare runoff or water-quality series for comparison with observations or infrastructure scenarios. The related catalogue EPANET record is a separate distribution-network model. No HSPF files or package were downloaded.
